newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa climbs on 1996 earnings - traders.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa climbs on 1996 earnings - traders.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico S.A. de C.V. (Ahmsa) had posted sharp gains in late trade on Tuesday following 1996 earnings reported during the session, dealers said.
"The market began to buy the stock yesterday, and they really liked the earnings report. Furthermore, the stock had lagged the market," a trader said.
"The word on the trading floor is that earnings came in much better than expected," another trader said.
Ahmsa's nominal shares gained 1.16 pesos to 17.64 pesos in late trade, while its ADRs were up 5/8 to 11-1/4 on Wall Street.
Ahmsa posted 1996 net earnings of 3.666 billion pesos at midday on Tuesday, compared to 645.9 million in 1995.
